title: Unrighteous
summary: UNRIGHTEOUS, adjective unri'chus. 1. Not righteous; not just; not conformed in heart and life to the divine law; evil; wicked; used of persons. 2. Unjust; contrary to law and equity; as an unrighteous

inlines.v: UNRIGHTEOUS, adjective unri'chus. 1. Not righteous; not just; not conformed in heart and life to the divine law; evil; wicked; used of persons. 2. Unjust; contrary to law and equity; as an unrighteous decree or sentence.
